steps.title: Your first run
steps.body: You are Teresā Albukerkē, and you lost the election. You have 72 hours to reach a jet and get out. This demo walks you to the border, and the airfield is yours.
steps.goal: Know the goal and the deadline

steps.title: Reading the scene
steps.body: The gold dot is you and the red eye is where Sosā is looking. When they sit on the same place, your exposure climbs. At 10 you are held, and the third hold is house arrest.
steps.goal: Read exposure and the inquiry on the map

steps.title: A round
steps.body: Every round goes News, Phone, Move, Roll, then Sosā. Answer your phone, make one call, make one move, and see what it cost you.
steps.goal: Know the five phases

steps.title: Your brother is on the phone
steps.body: Duartē has found a jet, but the crew will not book without a destination. Tap **Confirm Lāyūna**. The demo picked it for you.
steps.goal: Answer a message

steps.title: Start the aircraft
steps.body: Tap **Call Duartē about aircraft**. The call takes an hour, and his answer comes in six.
steps.goal: Start an arrangement by phone

steps.title: A promise is not a plane
steps.body: The route shows when Duartē owes you an answer, but he still has to come through. If he fails, you call again.
steps.goal: Tell a promise from a delivered arrangement

steps.title: Get out of the house
steps.body: Pick **Decoy convoy**, read the time and the roll it needs, then tap **Commit**. You can do this because Nando gave you the cars.
steps.goal: Read an approach before committing

steps.title: The die
steps.body: Cards lower the number you need, and they stay in your hand until you spend them or someone takes them back. You are in Santa Laura now, and Sosā still thinks you are at home.
steps.goal: See how cards change the roll

steps.title: Sosā moves too
steps.body: Every three hours the inquiry does something. This time Sosā sent the travel ban to every post, so the border is one point harder unless you can hold the paperwork back.
steps.goal: See the inquiry act on a schedule

steps.title: Ask for the visa
steps.body: Tap **Call Salek about your visa**. He can get Atlanta to let you in, but read his terms first, because calling him means yes.
steps.goal: Accept terms by calling

steps.title: Pay someone who takes money
steps.body: Nando's cousin does. Pick **Hire a driver and plain car**.
steps.goal: Use an ally who takes money

steps.title: Things moved while you drove
steps.body: Duartē booked the crew, and the inquiry told the papers you had left town. They are looking in Portô Venla, which is not where you are.
steps.goal: See arrangements progress while you travel

steps.title: Nonā Rosa needs something first
steps.body: Her cooperative's truck was impounded this morning. Pick **Help Nonā Rosa free the truck**. It costs three hours and makes her yours.
steps.goal: Earn help by helping

steps.title: People give you cards
steps.body: Nonā Rosa offers her truck and a driver, and that card will matter later. People who trust you are also slower to talk when Sosā leans on them.
steps.goal: Know that trust lowers the risk of betrayal

steps.title: Who meets you on the other side
steps.body: Tap **Call Duartē about reception**. He can reach Rosario Vélez in Esmeralda, and her people can be waiting at the line.
steps.goal: Arrange reception across the line

steps.title: Onto the freight
steps.body: Pick **Pay Holt for a crate**. Your truck card helps the roll. Do not pay the yardmaster, because he takes the money and calls Sosā.
steps.goal: Get a card for one place

steps.title: Midnight
steps.body: Holt's crate works in one yard on one night, and this is it. Tap **Board the midnight freight**. The card makes the roll certain and is gone when the train leaves.
steps.goal: Spend a card where it counts

steps.title: The line
steps.body: Three posts cross into Esmeralda, and one of them has been paid by Valdória. You do not know which. Vélez's people, if they come, cover one of the others, so you can cross now or wait for them.
steps.goal: Know where the second passport counts

steps.title: The rail post
steps.body: Pick **Cross at the Paso Huhūi post** and put your second passport on the desk. Read how the ban and your cards change the roll, then commit.
steps.goal: Read how the ban changes a roll

steps.title: Susana
steps.body: You made it across, but Esmeralda only lets you fly from here. Fuel the jet, get the visa, and go. Your party card means nothing in this country. Tap **Finish** and the rest is yours, with real dice.
steps.goal: Play the airfield alone

steps.title: Your first run as Sofīā
steps.goal: Know the goal and what you cannot see
steps.body: You are Sofīā Leōnī, aide to the incoming minister. Teresā Albukerkē has a jet booked for Tuesday afternoon, and your job is to stop her. You never see where she is, only reports, and reports come late.

steps.title: Reading the scene
steps.goal: Tell your search from her position
steps.body: The scene shows where your people are looking, and the box at the top says how old your last report is. She could be anywhere else on the route.

steps.title: A round
steps.goal: Know the five phases
steps.body: Every round goes Reports, Desk, Order, Roll, then Her move. Answer the minister, send one request, give one order, and read what comes back.

steps.title: The minister wants a town
steps.goal: Answer a message without guessing
steps.body: You do not have one yet, and if you guess wrong your own offices chase the guess. Pick **Ask for six hours**.

steps.title: Ask Esmeralda now
steps.goal: Start a slow request before you need it
steps.body: Your orders stop at the border, but Esmeralda can hold her for you. The embassy takes 10 hours to answer, so pick **Ask Esmeralda to hold her**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Put the ban on paper
steps.goal: Read an order before sending it
steps.body: Pick **Circulate the travel ban**, read the roll and the hours, then tap **Send the order**.

steps.title: A report is not proof
steps.goal: Judge a report by what it proves
steps.body: She moved while your order ran. Tap **Read the new reports**. Each report says what it proves and what it does not, and a car leaving a house is not her in the car.

steps.title: Things happen at the ministry
steps.goal: Weigh a choice by its tags
steps.body: Every few hours something lands on your desk, and each choice shows its cost. A real lead is true and a false one points the wrong way. When the card opens, pick **Check the one that gave plates**.

steps.title: A sent ban is not a closed border
steps.goal: Confirm a request reached the people who act on it
steps.body: The ban went out, but nobody at the post has read it. Pick **Confirm the ban at the post**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Act on the lead
steps.goal: Move the search to the newest report
steps.body: The plates were real. If they point somewhere new, follow them. If they point where you already are, search.

steps.title: How she gets caught
steps.goal: Know how searches turn into holds
steps.body: When your search sits on her stop, her exposure climbs, and at 10 she is held. The third hold is house arrest, and that is your win. She will run the moment she knows you are close.

steps.title: The rest is yours
steps.goal: Play on without the guide
steps.body: The dice and the news are real from here. The debrief at the end shows where she really was. Tap **Finish**.
